summary: Frontend-only testing of navbar link behavior fix in pgmei-shared.js (ajustarLinksNavbar). Validated: (1) On /pgmei3.html?cnpj=37411286000108 the 'Inicio' link href is /pgmei2.html?cnpj=37411286000108 and clicking it navigates to pgmei2 with session preserved (#pg-nome='LUCI SCHIAVI DA SILVA 42017335215', #pg-cnpj='37.411.286/0001-08'); (2) On /pgmei2.html?cnpj=37411286000108, 'Inicio' href stays /pgmei2.html?cnpj=... and clicking it keeps user on pgmei2 with session intact; (3) 'Sair' on both pages points to /pgmei.html and clicking goes to login with empty #cnpj; (4) Regression: 'Emitir Guia de Pagamento (DAS)' continues to /pgmei3.html?cnpj=... preserving CNPJ. All assertions passed on first run.
critical_code_review_comments: ajustarLinksNavbar in /app/frontend/public/pgmei-shared.js correctly routes 'inicio' -> /pgmei2.html?cnpj=..., 'sair' -> /pgmei.html, 'emitir guia' -> /pgmei3.html?cnpj=... The fix is minimal, idempotent and runs via PGMEI.init on both pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for navbar 'Inicio' link verified end-to-end on both pgmei2 and pgmei3. Previous iterations 1-7 already covered favicon/title/mask/banner/spinner/dropdown/year combo regressions. Use cache-buster &v=N if hitting stale cache.
